discrete_affine_ar1_recovery.failure_or_selection_reason: The discrete recovery is finite and stable in the tested windows but does not beat persistence on aggregate public MAE.
discrete_affine_ar1_recovery.interpretation: Recovery that permits a sign-changing discrete time-one map, unlike a continuous scalar ODE.

linear_autonomous_scalar_ode.failure_or_selection_reason: The positive time-one flow constraint is active in every rolling fit and aggregate MAE does not beat persistence.
linear_autonomous_scalar_ode.interpretation: Minimal autonomous scalar continuous-time skeleton with order-preserving time-one flow.

local_level_mean_w10.failure_or_selection_reason: This low-complexity recovery is finite but is less robust to the latest public observation than the selected median window.
local_level_mean_w10.interpretation: Low-complexity local-level recovery: forecast a fixed mean of the last 10 public observations.

persistence_last_value.failure_or_selection_reason: Frozen baseline retained for comparison; it is not the selected recovery model.
persistence_last_value.interpretation: Required baseline: carry the last observed public value forward.

quadratic_autonomous_scalar_ode.failure_or_selection_reason: Adding a quadratic autonomous drift does not beat persistence on aggregate public MAE and raises finite-sample sensitivity.
quadratic_autonomous_scalar_ode.interpretation: Nonlinear autonomous scalar ODE, standardized and integrated with fixed-step RK4.

robust_local_level_median_w10_recovery.failure_or_selection_reason: Finite robust recovery, but its fixed window has higher aggregate public MAE than median window 5.
robust_local_level_median_w10_recovery.interpretation: Low-complexity local-level recovery: forecast a fixed median of the last 10 public observations.

robust_local_level_median_w3_recovery.interpretation: Low-complexity local-level recovery: forecast a fixed median of the last 3 public observations.

robust_local_level_median_w5_recovery.failure_or_selection_reason: Selected by the predeclared rolling public criterion; no target values were used.
robust_local_level_median_w5_recovery.interpretation: Low-complexity local-level recovery: forecast a fixed median of the last 5 public observations.

robust_local_level_median_w7_recovery.failure_or_selection_reason: Finite robust recovery, but its fixed window has higher aggregate public MAE than median window 5.
robust_local_level_median_w7_recovery.interpretation: Low-complexity local-level recovery: forecast a fixed median of the last 7 public observations.

two_state_ar2_ridge_recovery.failure_or_selection_reason: The discrete recovery is finite and stable in the tested windows but does not beat persistence on aggregate public MAE.
two_state_ar2_ridge_recovery.interpretation: Two-state discrete recovery with fixed ridge penalty and explicit recurrence stability diagnostic.

autonomous_scalar_ode_sufficiency.limit: This is a falsification of adequacy for this public reduced-state forecast task, not an identification of a physical mechanism.
autonomous_scalar_ode_sufficiency.principle: For a one-dimensional autonomous continuous ODE with unique solutions, every fixed positive-time flow map is order-preserving; its affine linearization has p=exp(b)>0.

state_and_noise.consequence: The public output alone cannot identify hidden forcing, a latent state vector, or a physical conservation law.

public_integrity_verification.custody_order: private capsule encrypted and committed before public staging was released

validation_design.selection_rule: finite candidates ordered by equal-weight aggregate normalized MAE across all public rolling forecasts; ties by aggregate normalized RMSE, then fewer fitted parameters
